t: This is Gray's Inn Road, an important road in Central London, in the London Borough of Camden. It begins at its junction with Holborn, at the City of London boundary, and runs north through Holborn and King's Cross, ending at King's Cross railway station. It is part of the A5200. One name connected with it is Edmund Wingate, an English mathematician who died here in 1656. He was among the first to publish in the 1620s on Gunter's scale, and he also served as a Member of Parliament during the Interregnum.
